messages.text: Saw your car wasn't home yet. Long day at the lab again?
Yeah, the Raman run went past 6. Probably 44 on the timesheet this week.
You said the same thing last March hon. Three years in and they still push you.
It's the experiment weeks mom, you know how it goes. Normal weeks I'm out by 5.
the dentist office left another voicemail about scheduling that cleaning, sweetie
i know mom. i looked at the estimate sheet they mailed and the out of pocket is rough this month. car insurance just hit and the brake job ate the cushion
you keep pushing it back. that quote isnt going to get smaller
i'll call after the next paycheck. my sneakers from undergrad are also splitting at the toe and i need to figure out which one comes first
Are you free for 10? The Raman baseline is doing the weird staircase thing again and I need a sane second read.
Call me. Start with what changed since the last clean run, not what it says about you.
I almost put a dramatic story up and then deleted it. Calling you instead.
Good. Screenshots first, story later never.
you still at the lab?
leaving in 20. told myself 8pm cap and i'm going to actually keep it tonight
good. the Raman thing will still be broken tomorrow
i pinged Dr. Okafor about getting a second set of eyes on the baseline. didn't want to sit on it another week
Did Golden Valley send your reminder yet? I still have that paper from last April in the blue folder.
Aunt Linda sent me a scary clip about shots this morning. Can you look before I answer her?
Yes, portal says March 18 at 9:20. Can you bring the blue folder Sunday? I want to compare what I wrote down then.
Send it, but I am going to check the Merced County page and the CDC table first. If there is no original chart behind it, I would not pass it along.
That is fine. I just do not want to tell her the wrong thing.
I will. It had your sleep notes and the list of work things that were making your heart race, right?
I will also ask the pharmacist when I pick up Dad's refill after work. They usually know what changed versus what people are reposting.
That one. Nothing new to list except that I still have not set up any weekly thing or started a daily bottle.
honey the portal logged me out again, it says my session expired and now it wants the code from my email but the email isn't coming through
ok don't click anything else, give me 10 min and we can screen share. check the junk folder first, the code is from MyChart not the clinic name
found it in junk. also the referral pdf is in there but I can't tell if I'm supposed to print it or just show it on the phone at the front desk
I'll pull it up tonight and walk you through it. print one copy for your folder and I'll save a copy on my end too, that way if they say they don't have it we have the date stamp
Gallery reception Friday has those tiny pours again. Want me to save you a spot away from the patio door?
Yes please. I will do one tiny cup for the toast and then switch to sparkling water.
Kitchen table painting after instead of staying late?
Perfect. Paint, tea, and going home with my sweater not smelling like the patio.
did you ever finish that little riverbed wash you started last Sunday?
almost. pushed the desk lamp over to the corner so I could spread the half-pans out without bumping the laptop
the burnt sienna I got from the Riverside shop is way warmer than the one I had before, I want to do another layer tomorrow
send a picture when you do. also that Ursula K Le Guin one you said was on your shelf, can I borrow it after you?
yo did u see the clinic on M St might actually stay open? saw a flyer
Yeah Maya sent me the same one. I'm gonna call Costa's office tomorrow about funding for it
ofc u are lol always with the office calls. mom said she might go there for her bp check
That's exactly why it has to stay. Tell her I'll print the hours and bring them Sunday
This PG&E login is doing that thing where it pretends I know my account number.
Send me a screenshot with the total and due date showing. Blur the last four if you want.
You and your blur-the-last-four rules. Fine. Also Denise asked if you're coming the 15th or if lab stuff wins.
The 15th should work. Tell her I'll bring tortillas if Michael is making beans.
Did you see the Merced council clip from Tuesday? They finally posted use-of-force numbers but the categories are so vague it's almost useless.
I watched the whole thing. If they don't publish the raw counts by stop type it's just a press release. I want to see the denominator.
Same. And nothing about who reviews complaints. It's still the same chain reviewing itself.
That's the part that gets me. An outside panel would not be that hard. Even a quarterly audit by someone not in the building.
I can stop by after work Friday and look at that kitchen window latch if the manager hasn't fixed it.
Thanks. The Atwater office said maintenance is backed up, and I don't want the bedroom getting cold again overnight.
Leave the spare key under the blue planter if you're still at the lab.
Will do. Rent posts tomorrow too, so I am trying not to add another errand or surprise bill this week.
Aunt Carol shared that Bost cousin reunion thing on Facebook. June 13 at Woodward Park. Did you see it?
Yeah I saw it pop up when I checked the Outdoor Club page this morning. Marked it on my calendar already.
Good. Your dad asked if you saw the post about the Atwater Founders' Day potluck too, it's on the same page.
I'll scroll through after dinner. Trying not to be on my phone past nine, it gets in my head.
saw your kitchen-table pic, the foothills sketch is getting somewhere. the warm wash on the left ridge is doing a lot of work
Saw the spring rotation went up at Fresno Art today. The Ruth Asawa loans are still on the second floor. Wanna do a Saturday?
Yes. Studio Art Gallery too if we have energy after? Their new printmaker showed up on my feed three times this week.
thanks. tried lifting it back with a clean brush but the paper kind of resisted. arches cold press from that pad you gave me
Already following her. The cyanotype series. Let's plan museum first then walk to the gallery.
that paper holds a lot. if it's still too warm just go in with a thin cool glaze when it's bone dry. how was the drive back from atwater after dinner?
Perfect. I'll bring the small sketchbook in case we sit in the courtyard after.
fine, long. brought the small block back with me so i can keep poking at the hills tonight
you watching? fox is shooting like 1 for 9 lol
yeah ive got it on in the background while i prep my lunch. third quarter is rough
Sac vs Phoenix should NOT be this close. light the beam tonight pls
if they pull it off ill let you know. otherwise im going to bed at halftime
PurpleAir on the porch jumped to 138 overnight. Wind shifted from the burn south of Los Banos.
Saw it. Mom's inhaler refill is at Save Mart on Bellevue, can you grab it on the way back from the orchard?
Yeah. Crew shut down the spray rig at the Winton block too, drift's bad. Keep windows shut at the lab.
Will do. The Atwater school district just sent a recess-indoors text alert, Evan said the elementary kids are stuck inside again.
Bloom looks like itll come early in the Hilmar block this year. Soil already drying out south of Bradbury Rd.
That tracks. Drove past the orchard off Shaffer on Sunday, dust was already kicking up.
Yeah. Reminds me of the spring you turned 8, we were still in the Modesto house and the wells were already rough by April.
I remember. You and mom kept rationing the hose.
are you doing the volunteer board app tonight?
yeah, at the kitchen table now
quick q — does the 2022 brake light count for the traffic box if it was just a warning, no ticket?
a warning isn't a citation. write none. rest of the back page all clear too, right? then sign and date the bottom.
ok dumb question. when ppl say renters insurance is it the same bill as rent or separate
separate. mine is its own line in my budget sheet, like $14 a month next to the 1,250 for the apt
lmaooo of course u have a sheet. ok and u just pay it all yourself right no roommate splitting
yep all me. been doing it since i signed in early 2024. easier than splitting honestly
The little oranges are good right now. I can put some aside if you come by tomorrow.
Yes please. I am doing my Sunday fridge reset after laundry, so that helps.
Do you need olive oil too? I saw the big tin on sale.
Grab one if it is still there. I used the last of mine on the roasted vegetables.
Studio Art Gallery has the print show Saturday. Want to do that instead of the coast plan?
Your leftovers saved me after errands. The rice turned my lunch container bright gold, though.
Yes, local is better this month. I can do the gallery and coffee at my place after.
I know. I measured with the wrong spoon again. At least the cauliflower and lentils behaved.
Perfect. I will bring my sketchbook. Are you still making that big pot of soup?
Worth it. Also I keep thinking about Priya blocking that west route at the last second.
Tonight. Lentils, carrots, and rice, so lunches are handled and the application fee stays untouched.
That move was rude and perfect. Next time I am hiding the train map until after dessert.
If you drive up that way this month, check the coolant before the grade. I can look Sunday.
Thanks. I am not booking yet, just putting small bits aside and watching the tent sites.
Good. Also think about snow chains if the forecast drops.
I saved the chain note next to my apartment search filters: shade, not all pavement, somewhere I can get to trees fast.
Your mom put that CVS paper in the truck cup holder. Is that the one you needed for the school form?
Yes, thanks. It has the October line and the newer respiratory one, so I can upload both after breakfast.
Good. I didn't want it getting mixed in with the oil-change receipt.
Mom says dinner is 6:30. Are you doing your parking-lot laps first or can I steal your printer before?
I can print it after I do one loop. Bring the form, not a screenshot of half the form.
Rude but fair. Also I saw the tiny notebook in your bag, very serious detective energy.
It keeps my brain from inventing extra errands. Printer at 7:15.
finally opened the dna kit results. like 60% on the Murphy/O'Brien half, 35% Bauer side, rest is basically rounding error lol
Mom is going to say she already told us that
she literally just texted me 'told you so'. also the tree thing locks both sides in PA and Ohio back to like the 1880s. nobody from anywhere else apparently
That tracks. Save the screenshots, Mom will want them in the family file
Did tomorrow's slide deck finally stop fighting you?
Mostly. My brain keeps replaying the Q&A part and my shoulders are up by my ears.
Send me the 3 slides you're worried about. Also do the floor breathing thing before you open the laptop again.
Deal. I booked the Tuesday class too because sitting here refreshing the notes is making it worse.
tire shop wants 320 for the two fronts. ok to wait two weeks?
let me check the sheet. car fund is at 410 but 142 already went out for insurance this month. if I move the 60 from groceries I can do it the 21st without touching savings
the 21st works. dont skip lunch over it
added it to the grid in red so I dont forget. thanks dad
How was the river road yesterday? Dusty out there after the wind.
Dusty but good. I stopped too many times for seed pods and one bright green beetle.
Figures. Did that wrist thing say you got your climb in?
It gave me credit for 910 ft, so I am taking the win.
yo CFO Laura quick q. if i throw an extra 80 a month at my card vs my car which one first
card. always card. mine sits at zero each month and that's the only way I sleep. what's the interest on each
card is like 24 something. car is 6.9
lol then it's not even a question. kill the card. mine's the only loan I've got and I still throw extra at it whenever payday looks ok
How'd the second pass on the perovskite films go? You said the peak ratios were off last week.
Better. I re-prepped the batch from scratch, scratched the old labels, and pushed everything back through the 785 line. Baseline finally looks like a baseline.
Still have to rerun the IR on a couple of the doped ones tomorrow morning before I touch the data.
Good. Bad data isn't a moral failure, remember. Get the second run, then process.
how did the Raman rerun land today
rough. came home, closed the laptop, put on the Sleep album and opened the Le Guin again
ok good. better than scrolling at 11pm
just the lamp on, notebook on the left, tea. tomorrow Laura version of me can deal with the spectra
Mom said your kitchen light was on past 10 again last night.
Yeah, I'm doing two hours after dinner Mon Wed Thu now. Have to be.
Long haul. Don't burn the car out driving home tired Sundays.
you make it home? lights still on at the lab when i drove past 8
home now. had to redo a calibration curve, the MATLAB fit was off by a hair and I wanted to catch it before tomorrow
I won't. It's worth it. The sub-project I want next year, I have to actually know this stuff cold.
a hair won't matter to nobody but you
it matters to me. if the curve drifts the whole week of runs is junk. i wrote it down so future me knows what i changed
Mom found that tiny kitchen table pic where your AP Bio binder is taking up half the room.
That table was doing heroic work. Dad's work boots, your snack pile, my flashcards, Mom's coupon folder.
She says Rosa wants a copy if you scan it. No rush, just her monthly envelope thing.
I'll scan it after lab tomorrow and leave Mom the printouts Sunday.
yo did u see the thing about prop on the school bond
yeah I'm working through it now. Sun-Star endorsed yes, CalMatters has a decent explainer. county guide is dense as usual
lol u read all that?? just tell me what to fill in
not how this works lazy boy. read at least the CalMatters one, takes 10 min. envelope's gotta go in the box tomorrow for me
Coffee Thursday still okay? I can do the place by the bike shop at 6:10.
Yes. I need a non-lab hour. Elise sent a watercolor of the canal and now I want to see real sky.
Good. Also, if Evan sends you another form tonight, make him read the first page before you decode it.
That boundary may survive nine minutes.
You sounded worn out at dinner. Did you eat something real after lab?
Yes, leftover rice and eggs. I wrote a long post in my head and decided it can stay in my head.
Good. Send me the short version if you need to get it out. I can listen while I fold towels.
Short version: work was a mess, Maya talked me through the first part, and I just wanted to hear your voice.
bulb in?
yeah both sides done finally
good. didn't want a repeat of the merced ave thing. still the only one of those any of us has had
lol that was 4 years ago. dull bunch we are
Drove past Le Grand High today. Marquee said career day next month.
Oh perfect. I was going to email their counselor anyway, I want to bring two students out to tour the lab in April.
Kids out there don't hear about that kind of thing. Good.
That's the whole point. Nobody told me either til I was already at Merced.
honey the clinic portal redid the demographic page. it asks me an origin yes/no then a checklist below. I don't want to mess it up before tomorrow
First one is no for us. Second one just check the one box you always check. They moved it but it's the same answers as the school forms for me and Evan
just the one box? not two?
Just the one. Don't second-guess it
The purple wash you mixed looks like those rows in the photo you sent.
That Provence folder is too pretty. I keep using it as a color reference instead of buying another print.
Bring it Saturday. We can paint from that and your granite-cliff pictures.
Deal. I am also keeping rental screenshots that have real balconies or trail paths, not just parking-lot windows.
the conference one? you said yes right
yeah Pittsburgh in June. abstract is in
lol you over-planning the flight already
booked the one that gets me home Friday so i'm at dinner Sunday. not missing two in a row
coffee sat? my treat, you got groceries last time
sat works. and you don't have to, i'm fine — feb landed at like 2,650 with the tire repair but a normal month is 2,400 ish so i have room
you literally know your month to the dollar lol
tracking it is the only thing that keeps me sane when rent + everything else is on just me. 11am at the atwater place?
how is the practice exam study going
ok. I made a row per domain and a date column so I can see where I keep missing. it helps when my chest gets tight about it
rows and dates again lol. whatever works. you picked this route for a reason
yeah. paying tuition at 18 would have wrecked me. this way the lab covers most of it and I sleep better
Brake shop called back. They said the invoice should match the estimate.
Thanks. I am staying close to home until it posts. San Luis Obispo can wait.
Good. Need anything from our freezer before Sunday?
Maybe tortillas if Mom has extras. I am turning the last beans into chili for a few days.
sky's clear out here tonight. you got the little tube out?
set up at 8. Orion was sharp. just sat with it for like 40 min
your gramma would've called that her quiet time. she did the same thing on the porch.
yeah. it does something to me, the size of it. hard to explain
Did the portal take the pharmacy PDF, mija? The folder still has your little white card from the earlier rounds.
It took the PDF. I had to enter the lot numbers by hand for the fall one and the updated one.
Okay good. I wrote March 20 on my paper calendar in case they ask for anything else.
That helps. I'll keep the receipts clipped together so they don't disappear again.
Would Sunday afternoon work for watercolor, or is that your container-and-fridge window?
Could we do 11 instead? If I push that block too late I end up buying lunch Monday and Tuesday.
11 works. I will make tea and keep the table clear.
Perfect. I will bring walnuts and yogurt so I do not forget them on the way back.
Mom says Mrs. Vega has two tiny orange chaos machines again. You want me to tell her you're tempted?
Do not tell her that. I am gone from 7 most mornings until after dinner, and March already has rent, car insurance, and the lab shoes.
Fair. Also your place would turn into a shredded-paper crime scene by Tuesday.
Exactly. The Atwater shoebox barely has room for the drying rack and my desk.
If today ran long, want the canal loop before coffee instead of sitting with it?
Yes. Ten minutes outside would help more than staring at the ceiling.
I will bring peppermint gum. The cafe patio was rough last time.
Thank you. I will get one cider with food if we stay, then I am done because I still have to drive.
The almond trees are making everything yellow again. Did you take tissues in your bag?
Yes, tissues and the little blue packet. My eyes started burning before I got to 99.
Don't sit too long at that computer if your forehead starts doing that pressure thing.
I know. I'm going to stretch my neck after lunch and keep the screen dim.
you going to the march in modesto saturday or nah
Not this one. Working a long shift and I told Tasha I'd help finish the slide pack for the equity group at work.
lol classic. you ever actually showed up to one of these
I haven't. I read a lot, I send what I can when I can, and I push the workplace stuff. That's the lane I trust I'll actually keep up.
you were limping a little at the trailhead last weekend. is that the same pair you wore in the lab on rotation?
yeah the soles are basically gone. i keep eyeing the slip resistant black ones at Famous Footwear and walking back out
what's the holdup, $80?
$74 plus the Halverson consult copay i pushed off and the dental quote sitting on the fridge. one thing at a time
Read the draft of the Subbasin 5 GSP amendment. The pumping cap is going to hit the smaller almond growers in Winton hardest.
Dad's already talking about which blocks he'd pull. They're pushing harvest decisions a month earlier this year because of the well levels.
Did you see the Le Grand Union charter board pulled the ag-science extension funding? That program was the only science track for kids out past Plainsburg.
Saw the agenda. I'm signing up for public comment Tuesday. Same night as the Merced PM2.5 update from the Air District, so I'll be at the building anyway.
Air looks clear this morning. If you go up by Lake Yosemite, check your tire light before you leave.
Thanks. Maya and I are keeping it short, just the north trail and back.
Good. Text when you get home. I put the gauge on your porch.
Got it. I am throwing the little notebook in the car too so I do not carry the whole lab mess up the trail.
Mom said your fridge is packed again. Did the little square tiles people invade?
Four people, one very intense wall pattern, and apparently enough dal for a school cafeteria.
Classic. Did you make everything neon this time or did you show restraint?
Mostly restraint. My fingertips disagree, but the pot looked normal.
People are yelling in the comments again. One guy says the county is hiding numbers lol
Ask him for the meeting packet or dashboard link. Screenshots with red circles do not count.
You and your homework before opinions.
Especially when it is health stuff. If the county posts zip-code totals and dates, we can argue about whether the rollout makes sense after we read the same thing.
lol dad just handed me a paper that says 1095-B on it and asked if it's important. is it important
yes keep it. tell him to put it in the manila folder mom uses, the one with the rubber band. I need that one when I do their stuff next weekend
their stuff = the forms thing? you literally did yours like a week ago and you're STILL going back in
I told you I always do a second pass. I'd rather catch a wrong digit now than open a letter in June. theirs is simpler but I still want to read every box twice
u still at the bldg?? mom said dinner sunday btw
Yeah, doped pellets are still in the press. I want to label and bag them tonight or tomorrow morning is a mess.
girl. it's a sunday. the solar panels can wait
They can't actually. Dr. Aoki wants the spectra by Wednesday and the instrument time isn't mine after that.
Trail Saturday? Forecast looks decent.
Early start only. I need to be back at my desk by 4. Have a chapter to finish and a paper Dr. Halvorsen sent me on perovskite stability.
She gives you reading now? That's a shift from January.
I asked. I want her to see me as someone who could lead a piece of the next thin-film push, not just run her samples.
Planned Parenthood Mar Monte is asking for monthly sustainers, the Fresno health center one. I bumped mine to 25
Your story from yesterday at the museum. The Asawa wire piece against the window. That was a good shot.
Doing the same. Already on their list from the November thing. Will set up 15/month tonight
Thank you. Held my phone up like a tourist for ten minutes to get the light right.
Good. Also Border Angels water drop in May if you want in, I know your weekends are tight
Also the little watercolor you put up after. The dry hills one. The horizon worked.
Put me down. I can drive if we carpool from Atwater. Need to feel useful on something real
That one sat in the sketchbook for two weeks. I almost didn't post it. Elise pushed me.
sis question. if i want to track my gas spend by month is that a spreadsheet thing or do i need like an app
spreadsheet is fine. column for date, station, gallons, total. don't overwrite, just keep adding rows so you can see the trend
lmao of course you have opinions about this
if you don't write it down you'll think gas got worse when really you just drove more in feb. raw numbers first, conclusions later
Thursday hike still on? Forecast says 78.
did the special election thing for the water board ever go out? I feel like I missed a window
honestly same. I think that was the February one. I only noticed after the fact when the result hit local news
Can't. Experiment week, I'll be at the bench till 6:30 again. Saturday?
ugh. the small ones sneak past me every time
Sat works. You've been doing 45+ hour stretches a lot this quarter.
yeah. I'm good about the big ones, the small in-between ones I keep missing. need to put the registrar's calendar somewhere I'll actually see it
Only when runs stack. Normal weeks are 40 on the dot. Trade-off for keeping the PTO and the dental honestly.
Your mom wants the card for Rosa dropped at the post office before Friday.
I can do it Wednesday after work. Is Evan still taking the mower over?
Yes. Same circus as when you two were in school and everyone had a different pickup time.
Except now nobody is trying to finish algebra on the washing machine lid.
Honey what time works for you on the 14th? Dad wants to do something simple this year, maybe carne asada in the yard.
Tuesday is fine but I have a meeting til 10. Could come over by 11.
Perfect. I cant believe its 26 already. Feels like yesterday we brought you home from Doctors Medical Center.
Don't start. I'll bring the cake.
Aunt Patty asked if you're coming to the Easter service with them this year. I told her I'd ask.
tell her thank you but probably not. I'll come over for dinner after though
ok. she just likes to ask. she knows you haven't been since you were little
I know. I'll bring the rolls.
saw a thread tonight where everyone was tearing into a curator I really liked. it was getting nasty fast
ugh I avoid that app entirely now, every time I open it people are clawing at each other. it just leaves me jittery
honestly same. and then I make the mistake of scrolling IG after and seeing someone my age with a solo show and a loft and I spiral
yes. that's exactly why I'm putting the phone down. closing it before midnight or I will be measuring myself against strangers' apartments until 2am. talk tomorrow ❤
Are you joining the FOC Saturday one near Millerton, or saving your legs for lab week?
I signed up. If the air holds, I want the shaded side where the moss was last spring.
Bring the little lens then. Also check the route profile; I remember the last mile being rude.
Already synced it. My wrist graph says the rude part is 620 ft all at once.
are you still up for friday? trail's open past the second gate, light should be good around 4
yes please. can we stop where the oaks open up over the valley? i want to take a few reference shots for the block i started at elise's
the saddle viewpoint, yeah. bring the small notebook too, you always say the phone flattens the gold in the grass
exactly. golden hour does something the camera can't catch. swatches first, paint at home
Tire shop called. New control arm bushing on top of the brake job. $415 total.
ugh. ok. I can cover it but it's gonna come straight out of the savings cushion
I can float you half until next pay if it helps.
thanks dad, really. I'll pay it on the card and clear it Friday so it doesn't sit. just means I'm rebuilding the buffer over the next two paychecks. no big deal, just annoying
How did the Rao appointment go?
Pretty normal. She asked if I ever followed through after last year's screening page and I had to say no.
No shame in accurate reporting. Did she give you anything concrete this time?
A sleep worksheet, two names to call if I want, and a note to message her if mornings keep getting loud in my body.
Did you see what happened with that young man in Stockton on the news? They aren't saying much.
I saw. Whenever it comes out this slow I always wonder what would change if the family didn't have to fight for the file.
I just feel bad for his mom. You never know who they really listen to and who they don't.
That's what stays with me too. Whose hurt gets taken seriously the first time and whose has to be proved. Talked about it with Maya last week, same thing.
Can I send you three messy sentences and then we can talk about paint colors instead?
Always. Three sentences, then ultramarine versus sap green.
I keep opening the app like I want strangers to clap or scold me. Closing it. Sending to you.
Send it here. The app does not get a vote on your Thursday.
yo just realized the bost group chat is the dullest possible material for one of those true crime family podcasts
what brought this on lol
watching liana's tiktok about her dad's wild history. our parents' worst story is mom arguing w the propane delivery guy for 40 min
and my biggest contribution is calling 311 that one time about the couch on the curb. we are SO dull as a family
Saturday hike? Hites Cove if smoke holds
in. early though, want to be back before the house gets loud. i need a slow afternoon
6am trailhead works. also - the curve from Thursday, did you let yourself ask or sit on it
asked Priya. she caught the calibration thing in ten minutes. wish i'd done it Tuesday
is the hike sat morning still on or are you trying to push later
early is better. tip off is at 4 against the warriors and i told evan id come over
ok 7am at the trailhead then. you can have your couch time after
thank you. driving back through traffic during the second half is the worst
Are you coming for dinner Sunday? I can send leftovers back with you if you bring containers.
Yes, please. The fridge at my place is mostly coffee creamer, greens, and one very sad tortilla.
Bring laundry too if the machines are still acting up. Your dad can check the air filter you bought.
I will. I also need to make Monday's lunch before the long shift, so leftovers are perfect.
Mom says Sunday dinner is at 5. Also cousin Mark asked if you have a lighter in your car for the grill.
No lighter in my car, just pens, receipts, and the tire gauge Dad gave me.
Classic Laura inventory. Should I grab LaCroix or are you doing wine with Mom?
Grab LaCroix. I had my one glass at the gallery this month and I am fine with bubbles.
mom said you still havent booked that cleaning lol you over plan everything except your own teeth
the quote was $340 after what insurance covers and that doesnt count the Halverson sessions. i can't stack both this month
so which one wins
neither, probably. april. i'll wear the duct taped pair to lab one more rotation lol
Thanks for last night. The yogurt helped with the yellow lentils.
I should have trusted the teaspoon. I always think one more pinch will even it out.
The food was good. Also, Sam is going to ask for a rematch with the habitat tray.
He can have one after I finish cleaning bowls and finding the missing egg token.
I found your old blue Jansport in the hall closet with Evan's baseball glove stuffed inside it.
Of course he used my backpack as storage. That hallway was always a traffic jam.
Your dad says it was the year you were doing SAT practice at the table while dinner was still cooking.
Keep the photo for Rosa's envelope if she wants it, but don't let her mail me another check.
@thecuriouspigment just reposted your dry hills piece in her stories. Saw it this morning.
Wait what. She has like 40k followers. I'm going to pretend I'm calm.
Told you to post it. Kitchen table session this Friday? I have new gouache I want to try and there's that NIH science illustration account doing a live.
Friday works. I'll save the live so we can watch while we paint.
Studio Art is doing a small show Saturday, want to do the museum after?
yes. I want to grab another sheet of the cold press too, ran out doing test swatches at my desk last night
haha of course. how was the week?
long. ended up just lamp + Octavia Butler + that Richter piano thing on low for a couple hours. better today
the Trans Day of Visibility show at the gallery is the 31st, opening reception 6-9. there's a sliding scale thing
The bark curl picture you sent looks like a tiny spiral staircase. Can I steal that shape for a wash study?
Already RSVP'd. Putting 30 in for the artist fund. Are you bringing prints?
Yes. I took twenty versions because the creek light kept shifting.
